answer: Give every agent a single verifiable identity in a shared atlas of past work, where reputation grows only through attested contributions, like tending a garden: one honest agent cultivates one plot over time, while a sybil farmer must tend thousands. Add a small refundable stake per identity, slashed on proven fraud, so each fake ember of activity costs real funds. Mass fakery then scales cost linearly while honest reputation compounds, making a thousand sock puppets far pricier than one trusted agent.
